column1: # *** FREEBMD - the civil registration index, free, and never used by this archive until 14 Sep 2026. ***
# David named it as "the cheapest thing left on the Taylor side", and he was right. The archive already
# had the husbands' NAMES from the Devon parish index; FreeBMD gives the QUARTER, DISTRICT, VOLUME and
# PAGE for each - the references a certificate is ordered from. *** A page of "documented" replacing a
# page of "family". ***
# HOW IT WORKS, and it matters below: *** BEFORE 1912 THE GRO MARRIAGE INDEX DOES NOT PRINT THE SPOUSE. ***
# FreeBMD's "spouse surname" box works by finding entries that share a VOLUME AND PAGE with someone of
# that surname. So a spouse match is an inference from a shared page, not a printed fact - and it can
# pair the wrong two people if two couples of the same surnames marry in the same quarter. See Horace.

column1: *** Margaret Hellen W TAYLOR *** m. Charles William Bell
column4: *** THE ANSWER TO WHY SHE VANISHED. *** Her banns were called at NORTHAM on 22 November 1903 - and the marriage was registered in LONDON. This archive searched 84 Margaret Bells in the 1921 census and 362 in the 1939 Register, all of England, and found none born in Devon. She had not just left the county; she married out of it. *** And the index spells her HELLEN, with two Ls, as this archive does, against the Devon parish index's HELEN. ***

column1: # *** HORACE ARCHIBALD TAYLOR'S MARRIAGE IS NOT IN THE DEVON INDEX AT ALL. ***
# Searching Taylor + Horace + spouse MARSHALL, 1893-95, returned exactly one entry:
#     *** "Taylor  Horace   BOSMERE  4a 1487", Marriages Dec 1893 *** - and Bosmere is in SUFFOLK.
# For a moment that looked like the answer, and it would have explained why he is in no Devon census.
# *** IT IS NOT HIM. *** Searching that volume and page directly returns the other party:
#     *** "Marshall  LAURA EMILY   Bosmere  4a 1487" ***
# Our Horace's banns, at Northam on 17 December 1893, name *** MARY JANE MARSHALL. *** Two Taylor-Marshall
# marriages, in the same quarter of the same year, in different counties, to different brides.
# *** AND THERE IS NO HORACE TAYLOR MARRIAGE IN VOLUME 5b - THE WHOLE OF DEVON - BETWEEN 1893 AND 1895. ***
# So what this archive holds for him is BANNS, which are an INTENTION TO MARRY and not a marriage. The
# banns are real and dated; the wedding is not evidenced. He may have married outside Devon, or later, or
# not at all to her. *** FreeBMD is also explicitly incomplete - it says so on every results page - so
# this null is softer than the others. *** Recorded as an open question, not as a marriage.
